listing.name: Hegemony Wolf Rework
listing.summary: This is just a silly little thing I whipped up in an hour. The idea is to create an "upgraded" Wolf, interpreted through the lens of Hegemony doctrine. Please let me know if I succeeded.
listing.aiSummary: Upgrades the Hegemony Wolf with militarized auxiliary mods, extended shields, resistant flux conduits, and increased DP.

description:
This is just a silly little thing I whipped up in an hour. The idea is to create an "upgraded" Wolf, interpreted through the lens of Hegemony doctrine. Please let me know if I succeeded.

Mod features as of version 0.1:
-Militarized Hegemony Auxiliary Mod added to the Hegemony Wolf (As existed in ancient Starsector, but without the burn drive bonus)
-Extended Shield and Resistant Flux Conduits mods built-in
-DP increased to 6
-Reworked description prefix for Hegemony Wolf
